metaTitle: Twitch Song Request Bot for Spotify | ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Let viewers request Spotify songs with !sr in Twitch chat. Set request limits and manage the queue. Spotify Premium required.
title: Spotify song requests from Twitch chat.
lead: Let viewers add songs to your Spotify queue with !sr. The Twitch song request bot is free; your Spotify account needs Premium.
step1Desc: Create your own app in Spotify’s developer dashboard. Add its credentials on the Song Requests page, then connect your Spotify account.
step2Desc: Type !sr with a song name, artist and title, or a Spotify link. The bot finds the track and adds it to your Spotify queue.
step3Desc: Start Spotify playback on a device before accepting requests. Use !current in chat to check what your player is playing.
limitsNote: Set viewer quotas and the queue cap in the dashboard. Moderators can use !skip to skip a track.
faqQ1: How do viewers request a song on Twitch?
faqA1: Viewers type !sr followed by a song name or Spotify link in Twitch chat. You can also create a channel-point reward that accepts the same input.
faqA2: They go into your Spotify queue and play on your active device. The !current command reads your Spotify player, including tracks nobody requested.
faqQ3: Is the song request bot free?
faqA3: Song requests are included in ItsBagelBot’s free plan. You need Spotify Premium to use them.
faqA4: Yes. Set per-viewer quotas and a queue cap in the dashboard. Moderators can skip tracks with !skip and remove a queued request with !remove followed by its position.
faqQ5: What do I need on the Spotify side?
faqA5: You need Spotify Premium, your own app from Spotify’s developer dashboard, and a connection to your Spotify account. Start playback on a device before testing !sr.
faqQ6: I already use another bot. Do I have to start over?
faqA6: You can import commands from Nightbot, StreamElements, Moobot, Streamlabs Chatbot, Fossabot or WizeBot. Review the import before saving, then set up Spotify song requests.
faqQ7: Why was a song request refused?
faqA7: Check the bot’s reply in chat. Common causes are no active Spotify device, an account without Premium, or a connection that needs reconnecting in the dashboard. Failed channel-point requests are refunded.
faqQ8: Do requests work while I'm offline?
faqA8: Requests only work while you are live by default. Turn off Live only for !sr or the channel-point reward on the Song Requests page to allow requests between streams.
ctaTitle: Connect Spotify and try your first request.
tblNote: !sr takes a song name, "artist - song" or a Spotify link. Moderators can also use !remove with a queue position.
prereq1: Spotify Premium on your account, because Spotify only lets apps control the queue on Premium.
prereq2: Your own app, created in Spotify’s developer dashboard and connected to your Spotify account.
prereq3: Spotify playing on a device while requests come in.
listTitle: What to know before you turn it on.
item1Desc: Requested tracks are added to your Spotify queue. !current reads what your player is playing.
item2Desc: Requests only work during streams by default. Each request method has a Live only switch on the Song Requests page.
item3Desc: Choose who can use !sr in the dashboard, from everyone to broadcaster only.
item4Desc: Set the queue cap and how many pending songs each viewer tier can request. Your own requests are exempt from viewer quotas.
item5Desc: A channel-point request that cannot be queued gets its points back, and chat is told why.
